content:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we surfaced three repeat patterns and need concrete runbook + playbook edits so action items can close. Dropping owners and short deliverables here.

samir: I'll own the recurring-pattern analysis and the alert rules. Plan: add a Grafana alert for sustained kv_miss_rate spikes and a weekly query that groups incidents by deploy window. ETA 2026-04-14.

jin: I'll own the triage checklist + compact incident collector. Goal: a one-page TL;DR at the top of the runbook and `tools/incident_collector.sh` that runs 6 quick commands and uploads artifacts. PR by Mon.

cal: I'll update the escalation playbook with explicit PD services, paging thresholds, and the exact admin API calls for routing fallback. Will also add a 2-line exec-notify flow. PR by Thu.

olivia: Proposed paging thresholds to add to playbook: sustained p95 increase >9% for >7m OR error rate >0.6% for >5m. If agreed, cal add to PD snippet.

jin: Agreed. I'll include a short annotated command set for quick paste during an incident:
```bash
# runtime metrics snapshot (last ~50 lines)
curl -sfS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 50
# summarize model cache status
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
# get recent runtime logs (json lines)
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 400 -o cat --no-pager | jq -r '.message' | tail -n 400
# list model worker statuses
redwood-admin workers list --format json | jq '.[] | {id,status,model_variant,gpu_util}'
```
I'll annotate which metrics to check (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, model_load_time_ms, gpu_util) and include a tiny shell script that uploads to S3.

samir: From the recurring pattern side: ~6 incidents over last 3 months had a deploy within 8 minutes of the spike + a concurrent cache flush. Action: add a pre-deploy prewarm checklist and a post-deploy warm job for top prefixes. I'll open an issue RW-INC-5120 and link the dashboard.

cal: Escalation snippet I'll add to the playbook (exact calls):
```text
1) Confirm impact window and metric (p95, error_rate).
2) If p95 > threshold -> call admin route: PUT /admin/routing {"target":"fallback-variant"}
3) If kv_miss_rate > 5% -> POST /admin/cache/prewarm {"prefixes": ["popular:*"]}
4) If impact persists >20m -> page infra-sre and product-ops; if >40m -> exec notify.
5) After mitigation, run verification checks for 20m before closing.
```
I'll map each step to a PagerDuty service and include contact roles.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-5120: "playbook - recurring pattern detection, prewarm & alerts". Assigned to samir. Due 2026-04-14.

olivia: Final owners/due dates: samir - recurring-pattern dashboard & RW-INC-5120 (due 2026-04-14); jin - triage checklist + tools/incident_collector.sh (PR Mon 2026-03-30); cal - escalation mapping + PD services (PR Thu 2026-04-02). We'll do a 20-min sync Wed 09:15 to review diffs.

samir: I'll include a small dashboard panel showing deploy timestamps vs p95 drift and add a weekly alert that surfaces clusters.

jin: Sample incident_collector.sh I'll reference in the PR (short):
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
id="$1"
outdir="/tmp/incident_${id}"
mkdir -p "$outdir"
curl -sfS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 200 > "$outdir/metrics.txt"
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary > "$outdir/cache.txt"
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 1000 -o cat --no-pager > "$outdir/runtime.log"
redwood-admin workers list --format json > "$outdir/workers.json"
# internal uploader
s3cli upload "$outdir" s3://incidents/${id}
```
I'll call out what to inspect in each artifact in the PR notes.

cal: I'll also add a short rollback decision box for deploy-related incidents: if model_load_time_ms > 2x baseline and traffic routing change fails to reduce p95 in 10m -> rollback last deploy.

olivia: Good catch. Also add a verification checklist after any mitigation: p95 back to baseline-ish, kv_hit_rate stable for 20m, no new model load failures.

ops-bot: Comment added on RW-INC-5120: "link PRs here when ready; include dashboard URL in description".

olivia: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers put them here; otherwise we'll review PRs Wed and close the action items once merged. :rocket:
